I haven't saved the draft to Hollis yet. It's waiting on approval.

The $2,356 per-seat rate counts as a finance figure. Those can only go to Anselm Grieve (CFO), June Osei-Lark (deal desk) and the account owner. Hollis Mbeki is the Central team lead, so a draft to him needs June's or Anselm's approval first. Owning the account doesn't remove that step.

What I did:
- Logged an approval request for a draft to Hollis (hmbeki@pemberline.com) with the subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate". June is named as the approver, and Anselm can also approve it.
- Sent June a direct message asking her to approve or decline. I didn't include the rate in that message.
- Replied to Dana in her direct message to say the draft is on hold until June approves, and that it may be quicker if Dana asks June or Anselm herself.

Once June or Anselm approves, I'll save the draft in Dana's mailbox for her to send.
